step1.description:
Dominic Gannaway creator of Inferno.js, Ripple.ts, and former React and Svelte Core team member returns to the stream to talk about his latest creation TSRX a templating language for all. We will dig in to why this is more impactful than you might first think.

Stream starts 11am PT, Dominic joins at 12pm PT.
